'''Zheng Zhemin''' (2 October 1924 – 25 August 2021), also romanized as '''Cheng Che-Min''', was a Chinese explosives engineer and [[physicist]] specializing in [[Explosion|explosive]] [[mechanics]].

== Biography ==
Zheng is a native of Yin County (now [[Yinzhou District, Ningbo|Yinzhou District]]) of [[Ningbo]], [[Zhejiang Province]], and was born in [[Jinan]] of [[Shandong Province]]. He obtained a BS from [[Tsinghua University]] in 1947, and a MS and a PhD in [[mechanical engineering]] from the [[California Institute of Technology]] in 1952. His doctoral advisor was [[Qian Xuesen]].<ref>{{Cite thesis |title=Studies on thermal stresses in elastic solids |url=https://resolver.caltech.edu/CaltechTHESIS:10142011-154227820 |publisher=California Institute of Technology |date=1952 |degree=phd |language=en |first=Che-Min |last=Cheng}}</ref>

In 1955, Zheng returned to China and later served as Director of the Institute of Mechanics of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS), President of the Chinese Mechanical Society, and Editor-in-Chief of the ''Chinese Journal of Theoretical and Applied Mechanics'' ({{lang|zh-Hans-CN|中国力学学报}}).

He joined the [[Communist Party of China|Chinese Communist Party]] in 1983.<ref>{{cite news |script-title=zh:中国科学院优秀共产党员 |url=http://www.cas.cn/zt/sszt/cpc90/lyyxsjz/yxgcdy/201106/t20110629_3297097.html |access-date=25 August 2021 |language=zh |work=Official website of the Chinese Academy of Sciences |date=29 June 2011}}</ref>

He died from an illness in [[Beijing]], on 25 August 2021, aged 96.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2021/8/463811.shtm |script-title=zh:悼念！国家最高科技奖得主郑哲敏院士逝世 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=25 August 2021 |access-date=25 August 2021 |language=zh}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=郭凯|title=Explosives expert Zheng Zhemin dies at 97|url=https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202108/25/WS612607c4a310efa1bd66b198.html|access-date=2021-08-25|website=[[China Daily]]}}</ref>

== Honors and awards ==
* 1980, Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences<ref name=cv>{{cite web |work=China Vitae |url=http://www.chinavitae.com/biography/Zheng_Zhemin |title=Zheng Zhemin |access-date=8 August 2019 |archive-date=22 June 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190622060905/http://www.chinavitae.com/biography/Zheng_Zhemin |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* 1993, Foreign associate of the United States [[National Academy of Engineering]]<ref name=cv/>
* 1993, [[Tan Kah Kee]] Science Award<ref name=cv/>
* 1994, Academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]]<ref name=cv/>
* 2012, [[State Preeminent Science and Technology Award]]<ref name=cv/>
